visual.general_description: A printed Chinese-language motor nerve conduction table for the left and right ulnar, median, tibial and common peroneal nerves.
visual.detailed_description: A scanned-looking black-and-white table headed with the Chinese title 运动传导速度 (printed twice: as a large heading and as the table title row). The column header row prints Nerve, Lat, Amp, Dist and CV in white-on-dark cells with a second row of units ms, mV, mm and m/s. Eight group rows, each a Chinese nerve name followed by 运动 and 左 or 右 (in order: 尺神经 左, 尺神经 右, 正中神经 左, 正中神经 右, 胫神经 左, 胫神经 右, 腓总神经 左, 腓总神经 右), each followed by two data rows. The first data row of each group has a distal site label (腕 - ADM, 腕 - APB, 踝 - AH or 踝 - EDB) with only Lat and Amp values; the second has a proximal site label (肘-腕, 腘窝-踝 or 腓骨小头-踝) with Lat, Amp, Dist and CV values. There are 48 numeric cells in total (16 Lat, 16 Amp, 8 Dist, 8 CV). No flags, asterisks, reference ranges, dates or patient text are printed.
